text:
Marta: Quick question — our consumer SDKs are surfacing a single `APIError` for almost everything. That makes it hard for integrators to decide whether to retry, reauthenticate, or show a user-facing message. Can we agree on a minimal typed error surface (AuthError, RateLimitError, InvalidInputError, ModelSafetyError, TransientServerError) + a small set of fields like `retryable` and `hint`?

Sam: +1. Concrete mapping proposal: HTTP 401 -> AuthError, 429 -> RateLimitError (with `retry_after`), 400 (validation) -> InvalidInputError, 422 (safety/moderation) -> ModelSafetyError, 5xx -> TransientServerError. Add `code` (machine id), `message` (friendly), `internal_error_id` for support lookup.

Ryan: We have this shape in python already but JS/Go parity is shaky — Go uses sentinel types, python uses classes. For the JS SDK I'd prefer: `error.name` (string), `error.code` (string), `error.retryable` (bool), `error.hint` (string). Sample apps can then branch on `error.retryable`.

Tasha: Onboarding friction is real: our sample app should demonstrate handling each error type with clear UX copy. Eg for AuthError show a CTA "Reconnect account"; for RateLimitError show a backoff timer with a suggested retry delay from `retry_after`. I'll draft examples.

Marta: Two extra asks: 1) Do not leak raw stack traces in user-facing messages — keep them in logs and expose `internal_error_id` to customers for support. 2) Make the server error envelope stable so client SDKs can rely on fields (avoid burying info in `message`).

Sam: I also want `telemetry_reason` or `signal` preserved so Console can auto-group failures (e.g., `quota_exceeded`, `model_rejected`, `auth_expired`). That helps product triage.

Ryan: I'll open a small RFC with suggested JSON schema and a sample PR for js-sdk to start returning `retryable` + `hint`. Example error envelope I was thinking of:```json
{
  "type": "error",
  "error": {
    "name": "RateLimitError",
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Too many requests",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 12,
    "hint": "backoff 2s exponential",
    "internal_error_id": "xyz-123"
  }
}
```

Tasha: :eyes: I'll write the sampleapp snippet that consumes the envelope and shows CTA/hint. Also add unit tests for parity so onboarding demos don't regress. ETA: Friday EOD.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-442: "consumer-sdk: typed errors + user-facing hints + sampleapp" and linked this thread.

Marta: Great — thanks everyone. @Sam @Ryan @Tasha let's sync briefly tomorrow to agree exact hint wording and which SDKs get the initial PRs. :thumbsup:
